title: BONG OWASP ASVS5.0.0 Level2 evidence/applicability working register

source.selection: Every official requirement with L1 or L2;L3 intentionally outside this Level2 register.

assessment: NO ASVS COMPLIANCE CLAIM. Every mapped control is PARTIAL;unmapped and proposed exclusions are NOT RUN. No exclusion is approved.
scope: BONG application,provider configuration and deployment boundaries;provider-managed responsibility does not itself exclude a control.
releaseGates: Independent reviewer must assess each applicable exact control and approve each justified exclusion.
Unmapped control register remains an explicit SECURITY REVIEW PENDING gate.
Product-spec design choices such as email-only members do not silently satisfy a stricter standard requirement.
Actual hosted provider/TLS/edge/secret/logging/recovery configuration is unverified.
